description: Start from Figma (Pro and Team): make a new builder app from screens of a Figma design file. step status: whether Figma is connected (an Admin connects a personal access token in the dashboard, App builder, Start from Figma; this tool never sees or takes a token), maxPick and designCredits. step frames with link (a Figma file, page or frame link): the file name and key and the screens per page (id, name, width, height, section). step check with link and frames (screen ids from frames; a frame link alone picks its frame): readiness score 0 to 100 per screen with plain issues (no auto layout, default layer names, a flat picture without text layers, texts without text styles, a size that is not a phone screen or web page); no credits. step import with link, frames, name (up to 30 characters) and about (what the app does, a sentence): creates the app and starts its design step, which reads the screens, keeps their texts, colors and pictures (Figma image fills copied into the app) and maps them to the builder design blocks (close, not pixel exact). The design step costs designCredits (designSpec in builder_status prices, given back if it fails): tell the person the cost, ask, and pass confirm: true. kind mobile (default) or web. Follow it with builder_status. Errors say what to do: reconnect Figma, check access to the file, or wait when Figma limits requests. Developer role for frames, check and import.

about.description: What the app does, a sentence or two (import)

frames.description: Screen ids from step frames, like 12:34 (check and import)

link.description: Figma design file, page or frame link (https://www.figma.com/design/...)

name: builder_import_figma
title: Start a builder app from Figma
